name: screen_wrap
description: Entities that leave one side of the play area come back on the opposite side.

components.name: WrapArea
components.description: Size of the area an entity wraps around in, starting at the origin. wrap_x and wrap_y turn an axis off: a climber that leaves by the left edge and comes back by the right one, but is free to fall or rise, keeps wrap_y false.

systems.name: wrap
systems.description: Brings a Position that left its WrapArea back inside, on the other side.
